ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached image shows a blank square table divided into 3 rows and 3 columns, so there are 9 cells total. Reasoning: Since James wrote a different integer from 1 to 9 in each of the 9 cells, the total of all cell entries is 1+2+3+4+5+6+7+8+9 = 45. There are 3 row sums and 3 column sums, making 6 answers. If all 6 row/column sums are added together, each cell is counted exactly twice: once in its row and once in its column. Therefore the total of the 6 answers is 2 × 45 = 90. The five given answers sum to 12+13+15+16+17 = 73. Thus the missing sixth answer is 90−73 = 17.
